title: They Are Re-born, And Make Their Rounds
summary: Comparison is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: they are re-born, and make their rounds on the wheel of reincarnation; in all colors and forms, You are pervading
lifeApplication: Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
